(Remember the RUC were disarmed & B Specials disbanded after the Hunt Report after summer of ’69) Conservative PM Edward Heath demanded control of “law and order” in NI. Faulkner refused. Therefore, on 22 nd March 1972., Heath ordered Faulkner and senior Stormont members to Westminster. Faulkner believed talks about NI would happen. However, Heath presented Faulkner and the senior Stormont members his proposed changes. 1) Transfer of security control to Westminster. 2) Referendum of future of the Irish border between NI & ROI. 3) Gradual removal of internment. 4) Introduction of a Secretary of State for NI. 5) Political talks with other NI political parties to create a “community government” – Catholics to be included. Brian Faulkner and the entire NI government resigned – they could not accept the loss of control over security.
